# daisysp in ToneGrid 1.1.9

Upstream: https://github.com/daisyaudio/DaisySP
Pinned commit: `2c72eaf9eac5fc0dca1919d65d606da907832618`. Tag: commit pin.
License: MIT; preserve the complete supplied LICENSE in copies or substantial portions.
All copied upstream files are unchanged; source-manifest.json lists paths and SHA-256.
License is also shipped under Resources/Licenses and beside the executable.

Only Chorus, Tremolo, Phaser and Flanger plus required Oscillator, dsp.h and delayline.h are integrated. ToneGrid-owned ModProcessor hides all DaisySP APIs in its implementation. The upstream LICENSE includes Electrosmith, Emilie Gillet and Paul Batchelor notices, retained verbatim. No unrelated module is imported. The optional CUSTOM_DSP compile switch is not enabled.
